questions.question: Find the smallest 8 digit number which is exactly divisible by 121.

questions.question: If the in-radius of the equilateral triangle is 8 cm then what is the value of circum-radius (in cm) of the triangle?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

In-radius of equilateral triangle = 8 cm

**Calculation:**

Ratio of in-radius to circum-radius in equilateral triangle = 1 : 2

Let in radius of the equilateral triangle is x. So, circum-radius of the equilateral triangle is 2x.

Given that,

The in radius of the equilateral triangle is 8 cm

⇒ x = 8

Circum-radius of the equilateral triangle = 2x = 2 × 8 = 16 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 16 cm.**

questions.question: The average of 7 numbers is 30. If the average of first three numbers is 25 and that of last three numbers is 35, then what is the fourth number?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average of 7 numbers = 30

Average of first 3 numbers = 25

Average of last 3 numbers = 35

**Calculation:**

Average of 7 numbers = 30

So, Sum of 7 numbers = 30 × 7 = 210

Average of first 3 numbers = 25

So, the sum of first 3 numbers = 25 × 3 = 75

Average of last 3 numbers = 35

So, the sum of the last 3 numbers = 35 × 3 = 105

Fourth number = Sum of 7 numbers - (sum of first 3 numbers + sum of the last 3 numbers)

⇒ 210 – (105 + 75) = 210 – 180 = 30

**∴ The correct answer is 30**

questions.question: If the interest is compounded half-yearly, then what will be the compound interest (in Rs.) on a sum of Rs. 10000 for 1 year at the rate of 10% per annum?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total sum = Rs.10,000; Time = 1 year; Rate = 10 %

**Calculation:**

If interest is compounded half-yearly, then

Rate of interest (r) = 10/2 = 5% and time (t) = 1 × 2 = 2

Total CI percentage in 1 years = 5 + 5 + (5 × 5)/100

⇒ 10 + 0.25 = 10.25%

Required interest = 10,000 × 10.25/100 = 1025

**∴ The correct answer is Rs.1025.**

questions.question: Raj purchased two laptops, first for Rs. 42500 and the second for Rs 36200. He sold first laptop at a profit of 12% and the second laptop at a loss of 12%.What is the overall profit or loss?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

C.P of first laptop = Rs.42500

C.P of second laptop = Rs.36200

**Calculation:**

CP of first laptop = 42500

Thus, SP of first laptop = 42500 × 112/100 = 47600

CP of second laptop = 36200

Thus, SP of second laptop = 36200 × 88/100 = 31856

Total CP of first and second laptop = 42500 + 36200 = 78700

And total SP of first and second laptop = 47600 + 31856 = 79456

Profit = Total SP – Total CP = 79456 – 78700 = 756

**∴ The correct answer is Rs.756.**

questions.question: A discount of 45% on an article is equal to the discount of 65% on other article. What is the respective ratio of the marked price of both the articles?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Let MP of first article = x

And MP of other article = y

Then, according to the question,

x × 45% = y × 65%

⇒ x/y = 65/45

⇒ x : y = 13 : 9

Respective ratio of the marked price of both the articles = 13 : 9

**∴ The correct answer is 13 : 9.**

P and Q together can make a door in 12 days. They started the work together but after 8 days P left the work. The remaining work is completed by Q alone in 7 more days. In how many days can P alone complete the entire work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

P and Q together can make a door = 12 days.

**Calculation:**

Let total work = 1

Work done by (P + Q) in 1 day = 1/12

Work done by (P + Q) in 8 days = 8/12

Remaining work = 1 – 8/12 = 1/3

And 1/3rd part of work complete by Q = 7 days

So, whole work complete by Q = 7 × 3 = 21 days

P can alone complete the entire work = 1/[1/12 – 1/21] = 1/1/28 = 28 days

**∴ The correct answer is 28 days.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**Concept used:

Efficiency × time = total work

**Calculation:**

Total work = (P + Q) × 12

According to the question:

⇒ (P + Q) × 8 + Q × 7 = (P + Q) × 12

⇒ Q × 7 = (P + Q) × 4

⇒ Q × 3 = P × 4

⇒ P/Q = 3//4

Now, total work = (P + Q) × 12

⇒ (3 + 4) × 12 = 7 × 12 = 84

P alone complete the entire work = 84/3 = 28 days

**∴ The correct answer is 28 days.**

questions.question: From point P, at 6:30 pm, a train starts moving towards Q with the speed of 40 km/hr. Another train starts moving from point Q at 7:30 p.m. towards point P at the speed of 60 km/hr. Both of them meet at 11:30 p.m. at point R. What is the ratio of PR and QR?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed of train A = 40 km/hr

Speed of train B = 60 km/hr

**Calculation: **

Let train A with 40 km/hr speed starts from point P, moving towards point Q

And train B with 60 km/hr speed stars from point Q, moving towards point P.

Time taken by train A to reach at point R = 5 hr

And time taken by train B to reach at point R = 4 hr

Distance covered by train A to reach at point R = 5 × 40 = 200

And distance covered by train B to reach at point R = 4 × 60 = 240

Thus, PR = 200 km & QR = 240 km

PR : QR = 200 : 240 = 5 : 6

**∴ The correct answer is 5 : 6.**

questions.question: If the length of one side and the diagonal of a rectangle are 5 cm and 13 cm respectively, then find its perimeter (in cm).
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Diagonal of rectangle = 13 cm

Side of rectangle = 5 cm

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b3409cadf0387f283a8a080af56045afe9f782e2e8da6b1cb38e1c5d642cba3.png] 

AC = 13 cm & BC = 5 cm

In right triangle ABC

By Pythagoras Theorem:

⇒ (AC) ² = (AB)² + (BC)²

⇒ (13) ² = (AB) ² + 5²

⇒ AB = 12

So, Length of the rectangle (l) =12

And the breadth of the rectangle (b) = 5

Perimeter of the rectangle = 2 (l + b)

⇒ 2 × (12 + 5) = 2 × 17 = 34 cm 

**∴ The correct answer is 34 cm.**

questions.question: If the perimeter of a semicircle is 108 cm, then find the area (in cm²) of the circle.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Perimeter of a semicircle = 108 cm

**Calculation:**

Perimeter of semicircle = πr + 2r

⇒ 108 = πr + 2r

⇒ 108 = (22/7 + 2) × r

⇒ 108 = 36/7 × r

⇒ r = 21 cm

Area of circle = πr² = 22/7 × 21 × 21 = 1386 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 1386 cm2.**

questions.question: The surface area of a sphere is 2464 cm². Find its diameter (in cm).
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Surface area of sphere = 2464 cm2

**Formula used:**

Surface area of sphere = 4πr2

**Calculation:**

Surface area of sphere = 2464

⇒ 4 × 22/7 × r² = 2464

⇒ r2 = 196

⇒ r = 14

Diameter of the sphere = 14 × 2 = 28 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 28 cm.**
